title: RawItem
description: Shape of a raw pipeline item at <vault>/_pipeline/raw/<source_kind>/<id>.md. Frontmatter fields required by all processors.

source_id.description: Unique identifier within the source kind (e.g. video ID, post ID, URL slug).

collected_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the item was collected.

original_url.description: Canonical URL of the original content.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw body content (without frontmatter).

source_url.description: Alias for original_url; accepted for backward compatibility.
